verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk and centred: about 160px of dead space on each side, a weak one-line headline, the SOLSTICE can label illegible, and the circle and CTA nearly touching the top and bottom edges. B reads left to right as a banner and the headline clearly dominates, but the GLACIER logo floats off-axis (centred, not aligned to the headline's left edge), the body copy is jammed at the bottom edge, and the badge/CTA column sits on its own baseline, apart from the copy.
